candidate_matches.title: Workspace store flush serializes across immediate, debounced and shutdown paths
candidate_matches.why: It fixes the exact same failure signature (ENOENT: rename 'workspaces.json.tmp' -> 'workspaces.json' from two writers sharing one fixed tmp path) but its serialization is an in-process promise chain inside flushToDisk/WorkspaceService, which cannot coordinate two separate OS processes sharing one checkout, so the new requirement's cross-process EPERM/ENOENT/interleave scenario is explicitly out of what this requirement's mechanism covers even though the requirement text never says so.

candidate_matches.title: A rejected store write rolls back the session and the tab that addTab created
candidate_matches.why: This is about addTab's in-memory rollback behavior when a store write is rejected for any reason, not about the write mechanism itself or tmp-file naming/collision, so it is adjacent (same WorkspaceService, same store-write failure trigger) but does not touch atomicity or multi-instance concerns.

candidate_matches.title: Recovery option persistence and validation
candidate_matches.why: Its AC-6 requires concurrent mutations to leave valid JSON with each mutation reflected exactly once, and its trace links explicitly cite CommandPresetService.ts:216-290 as the 'serialized mutation and atomic write pattern' to reuse, corroborating that the same fixed-tmp-path, per-process atomic-write pattern exists in a second store beyond workspaces.json, but it does not itself require or cover cross-instance safety.

scope_boundary_items.text: Making split WebSocket the default socket topology. This exclusion covers socket topology only and does not restrict the terminal data plane wire format, which is in scope.
Replacing xterm.js or the terminal rendering engine.
Changing AI TUI idle/running semantic invariants.
The default WebSocket transport mode remains `unified`.
The terminal data plane wire format is controlled by `realtime.terminalWireFormat`, which is independent of `wsTransportMode`; the control plane stays JSON in every mode.
Split WebSocket is a feature-flagged transport mode and must remain rollback-safe.
Browser main-thread rendering stalls are mitigated by visible output scheduling; split WebSocket alone is not sufficient.
Agent-run live validation must use `https://localhost:2222`; health checks use `http://localhost:2221/health`.
Raw terminal input must not be written to debug logs when backpressure or reconnect handling occurs.
